install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/kottomkt
for site_dir in creative-rebuild editorial-rebuild; do
  if [ -f "$site_dir/package-lock.json" ]; then
    (cd "$site_dir" && npm ci --ignore-scripts --cache /tmp/kotto-npm-cache)
  fi
done
start_skill:
This is a static Korean marketing website at /workspace/kottomkt. Use the existing checkout; cloud tasks are already isolated. Do not create a Git worktree unless explicitly requested. There is no package manifest, build, dependency installation, database, or required secret for local development. Keep tracked source and lockfiles unchanged during environment setup.
Start from /workspace/kottomkt: python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 (keep the process in a managed terminal session). If port 8000 is occupied, inspect the existing service before reusing it or choose another port. Processes must be restarted in new tasks; installed files persist. Do not expose localhost preview links.
Verify HTTP 200 and expected Korean page content for /index.html, /services.html, and /contact.html, plus /styles.css and /script.js. Run node --check script.js. A full readiness check should fetch all 12 HTML files and their local href/src resources, and compare served content with the checkout. Python 3, Node.js, Chromium, and Python Playwright were already available; no install script is required.
Browser checks: homepage preloader hides; mobile hamburger opens the menu and Escape closes it; contact phone input formats 01012345678 as 010-1234-5678. Do not submit real EmailJS messages without explicit authorization. The EmailJS SDK is served by cdn.jsdelivr.net (existing package-manager network preset). Fonts require fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com; icons require cdnjs.cloudflare.com; the optional map iframe uses www.google.com. These custom network domains are saved in the draft but require settings application/publication and revalidation. Never disable TLS verification; Chromium may need the platform CA certificates from /usr/local/share/ca-certificates imported into its user NSS trust store. curl with system trust successfully fetched the EmailJS SDK. Current-instance browser interaction checks passed; external font/icon loading was blocked by the current network policy. Real email delivery and the external map have not been validated.
Check git status --short before and after setup; no repository edits are required.

Editorial rebuild addition: The original root remains a static site. The selected full 12-page B rebuild is /workspace/kottomkt/editorial-rebuild on codex/kotto-creative-rebuild; creative-rebuild contains the earlier 3 concepts. Use existing checkout and preserve unrelated dirty root files. No worktree unless explicitly requested. If the rebuild folder exists, npm ci --ignore-scripts --cache /tmp/kotto-npm-cache there, then npm exec vite -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4180 in a managed terminal session. For production validation, npm exec vite build (uses committed generated HTML without regenerating tracked pages), then npm exec vite preview -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4181. Verify expected page content and HTTP 200 for all 12 HTML routes and their assets. These internal addresses are not public user previews. Local fonts/artwork are bundled; no external CDN is required for rendering. EmailJS uses existing client configuration; actual delivery requires permitted origin/network. Never send real test mail; qa/audit.py mocks the SDK and blocks API calls. Python Playwright and /usr/bin/chromium support the browser QA. Runtime processes do not persist into fresh tasks. Source/build/share instructions are in editorial-rebuild/README.md. This setup instruction does not publish the website or environment.
